main_goal.text: Make the local/develop KoDigital Homepages CMS a true multi-site CMS with a legacy-style KoDigital admin UX, where every one of the 30 REQ items has an artifact-backed proof route exercised by deterministic local commands or executed Playwright runs, and the new Q1-Q4 quality gates (mission_goal_trace, source_context_pack, wire_protocol_parity, manualqa_goal_coverage, reviewer_artifact_diff_plan) prove the prior weak-proof failures cannot reoccur.
main_goal.storage_surface: local D1 (kodigital-cms-local) + local R2 fake binding + local file system
main_goal.time_window: develop session only; live cms.kodigital.app is production_pending
main_goal.failure_criterion: Any in-scope REQ lacks browser/DB/API proof; OR ManualQA accepts PASS with in-scope sub-failure; OR evidence_source=semantic_review_only is used for REQ-006/007/008/009/010/011; OR migration 0007 is not applied locally; OR test-results/ is absent after the Playwright run; OR any 'TheIWise' / 'a2z-cf-cms-v1-*' / '44c73f76-6ed5-4b26-b442-6c2044326c4d' / 'psychic-quiz' reference appears in active runtime config.

in_scope: REQ-010 site-aware Media filters (filter only; upload is production_pending)
REQ-016 full admin nav across every admin page
REQ-017 New Site modal posts real /api/admin/sites
REQ-018 newly created site row renders after creation
REQ-019 provisioning polling starts from browser UI
REQ-020 About page provisioning inserts pages row
REQ-023 Playwright browser tests prove admin UX parity
REQ-024 off-ADMIN_HOST /admin returns 404 + no-store + noindex/nofollow + no leak
REQ-026 local D1 migrations apply + assert tables/indexes/constraints/seed
REQ-027 R2 dry-run binding proof (upload itself = production_pending)
REQ-028 no real Cloudflare route/DNS/cache mutation
REQ-029 no legacy production refs in active config
out_of_scope: wrangler deploy / wrangler d1 --remote / wrangler secret put/delete
real Cloudflare route / DNS / cache mutation
OpenAI calls / full AI content generation
public final facelift templates beyond Phase 3/3R
R2 actual upload path (production_pending per T9.AC3)

mutating_actions: filesystem writes to api/test-results/ during Playwright runs

infra_prerequisites.name: local Worker running on http://127.0.0.1:8787 (wrangler dev) for Playwright + curl tests
ADMIN_HOST env var set to cms.kodigital.app in [vars]
SITE_PROVISIONING_DRY_RUN env var set to 'true' in [vars]

stories.title: Apply migration 0007 locally and prove per-site slug UNIQUE replaces legacy global slug UNIQUE

acceptance_criteria.criterion: cd api && npm run db:migrate:local returns exit 0 (all 7 migrations apply)
acceptance_criteria.command: cd api && npm run db:migrate:local

acceptance_criteria.criterion: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN local D1 with migrations 0001-0007 applied, WHEN we query sqlite_master for index 'idx_articles_site_slug_unique', THEN exactly 1 row returned and 0 rows for legacy 'idx_articles_slug_global'.
acceptance_criteria.command: cd api && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-cms-local --local --json --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='index' AND name='idx_articles_site_slug_unique';"

acceptance_criteria.criterion: BEHAVIORAL: GIVEN two sites A and B exist, WHEN we INSERT an article with slug='about' for site A then slug='about' for site B, THEN both inserts succeed (no UNIQUE violation across sites); WHEN we INSERT a second slug='about' for site A, THEN UNIQUE violation is raised.
acceptance_criteria.command: cd api && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-cms-local --local --json --command "PRAGMA index_list('articles');"

scenarios.title: Admin shell parity: no Phase 1 shell; full legacy layout + classes + KoDigital brand
scenarios.why: REQ-014/015/022 demand legacy-style admin UX with KoDigital brand; prior sessions rendered the Phase 1 placeholder shell. This scenario proves the full legacy layout renders.
scenarios.action: Open http://127.0.0.1:8787/admin (Host: cms.kodigital.app). Inspect DOM for required class set (admin-layout, admin-sidebar, sidebar-nav, admin-main, admin-header, admin-content, stats-grid, stat-card, card, toolbar). Inspect brand text.
scenarios.expected: All required classes present. Brand text matches /KoDigital CMS|Homepage CMS/. No 'Phase 1', 'TheIWise', or 'Psychic Quiz' visible.

scenarios.title: Domains tab table + actions + New Site modal visible with full nav
scenarios.why: REQ-003/016 require Domains tab with full nav across every admin page. Prior sessions rendered partial nav or missed Domains UX.
scenarios.action: Open /admin/domains. Count sidebar nav entries. Verify Domains table columns: domain, site, vertical, activity, status, articles, created, last provisioned, actions. Click 'New Site'; verify modal opens.
scenarios.expected: 9 sidebar nav entries. Table renders with 9 columns. Modal renders with name/domain/vertical/activity inputs.

scenarios.title: New Site browser flow: modal -> POST /api/admin/sites -> row appears -> polling starts
scenarios.why: REQ-004/017/018/019 require real wiring. Prior sessions had stub-only proof. This scenario observes the network request body, response, and UI state update.
scenarios.action: Open /admin/domains. Click New Site. Fill name='Demo Acme', domain='demo-acme.example', vertical=Wellness, activity=Magazine. Click Create. Observe Network tab.
scenarios.expected: POST /api/admin/sites with JSON body containing 'name' key. Response 201 with site_id. Domains table immediately shows new row. Provisioning polling panel appears.

scenarios.title: Provisioning 15-step completion + idempotent rerun
scenarios.action: Run provisioning-runner.test.ts: invoke POST /provision/next 15 times then a 16th time.
scenarios.expected: site_creation_jobs has 1 row; site_creation_job_steps has 15 rows; 16th call inserts no new rows.

scenarios.title: D1 rows created for site/domain/job/steps/settings/about/legal pages/categories
scenarios.action: After MQA-3 + MQA-4, query D1 for each table.
scenarios.expected: sites:1, domains:1, site_creation_jobs:1, site_creation_job_steps:15, site_settings:12, pages WHERE page_type='about':1, pages WHERE page_type='legal':>=2, site_categories:>=1.

scenarios.title: Articles site-required editor + tenant boundary 403
scenarios.why: REQ-006/021 demand site-aware articles + tenant guard.

scenarios.title: Pages / About site-aware behavior
scenarios.why: REQ-007/020 demand About page provisioning + site_id filter.
scenarios.action: Open /admin/pages. Inspect filter inputs. Run provisioning. Query DB.
scenarios.expected: select[name=site_id] + select[name=page_type] with option=about. After provisioning, pages WHERE page_type='about' AND site_id=X count = 1.

scenarios.title: Categories multi-vertical allocation
scenarios.why: REQ-008 demands category_verticals rows per allocation.

scenarios.title: Settings site-scoped save + version bump
scenarios.why: REQ-009 demands settings_version bump per site.
scenarios.expected: site X settings_version = previous + 1; site Y unchanged.

scenarios.title: Media / Tags site/global filters
scenarios.why: REQ-010/011 demand site-aware Media + Tags filters that distinguish site-scoped rows from globally-shared rows; prior sessions had placeholder list endpoints with no real filtering.
scenarios.expected: Media returns site+global rows; Tags returns site rows only.

scenarios.title: Cloudflare dry-run: no outbound api.cloudflare.com
scenarios.why: REQ-013/028 demand zero real Cloudflare mutation.
scenarios.expected: 0 fetch calls to api.cloudflare.com; cache_purge_log dry_run=1 row written.

scenarios.title: Public-domain /admin 404 + no-store + noindex/nofollow + no cms.kodigital.app leak
scenarios.expected: HTTP 404; Cache-Control: no-store; X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow; body has no 'cms.kodigital.app' literal.

scenarios.title: Protected-domain rejection at POST /api/admin/sites
scenarios.why: REQ-025 demands TheIWise + protected domains rejected.
scenarios.expected: HTTP 400 with protected_domain_rejected reason; zero sites/domains rows inserted.

scenarios.title: No legacy production refs in active config
scenarios.why: REQ-029 demands an active config that contains zero references to legacy production identifiers (TheIWise hosts, the legacy a2z-cf-cms-v1 worker/db, the 44c73f76 UUID, or psychic-quiz funnel).
scenarios.expected: Exit 0. Zero matches for theiwise.com / a2z-cf-cms-v1-api / 44c73f76-6ed5-4b26-b442-6c2044326c4d / psychic-quiz in active config.

scenarios.title: Live-domain status explicitly production_pending
scenarios.expected: live cms.kodigital.app classification = production_pending; develop_target = local.

scenarios.title: R2 / media proof or explicit production_pending classification
scenarios.why: REQ-027 demands R2 dry-run binding proof OR explicit production_pending.
scenarios.action: grep MEDIA binding in wrangler.toml; verify T9.AC3 classification.
scenarios.expected: MEDIA binding present in wrangler.toml; R2 upload classified production_pending in test_contract T9.AC3.
